steps.en: Officer lands on a dashboard page after login
steps.id: Officer masuk ke halaman dashboard setelah login
steps.why_en: The dashboard page exists but is completely empty.
steps.why_id: Halaman dashboard ada, tetapi isinya kosong sama sekali.

steps.why_en: No notification or alert feature for officers exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada fitur notifikasi atau alert untuk officer.

steps.en: Dashboard summarises pending work items routed to the officer
steps.id: Dashboard merangkum pending work item yang di-route ke officer
steps.why_en: The work item menu is hidden and work item creation is still a stub.
steps.why_id: Menu work item disembunyikan dan pembuatan work item masih stub.

steps.en: Dashboard lists reports routed to the officer
steps.id: Dashboard menampilkan laporan yang di-route ke officer
steps.why_en: Reports are emailed to a list, not routed to a dashboard.
steps.why_id: Laporan dikirim lewat email ke daftar, bukan di-route ke dashboard.

steps.en: Officer clicks into a work item from the dashboard
steps.id: Officer klik work item dari dashboard
steps.why_en: There is no work item on the dashboard to click.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item di dashboard yang bisa diklik.

steps.why_en: Reports can be downloaded from the Report menu, not from a personal dashboard.
steps.why_id: Laporan bisa diunduh dari menu Report, bukan dari dashboard pribadi.
